<!--
FDIC-BRC / JFQA revision v4: capital-distance heterogeneity table.
Does the same disclosed charge move uninsured funding more where the
2022Q4 capital buffer absorbing it is thinner?  Moderator: equity/assets
frozen at 2022Q4, winsorized at bank-level 1st/99th percentiles.
Outcomes: uninsured time deposits/assets (level DiD) and the within-bank
uninsured-minus-insured gap (equivalent to the bank x quarter FE triple
difference).  Expected: negative treatment effect at low capital,
positive interaction with capital.
Input: panel_smallbank (fallback vintage).
Output: tbl_capital_het_20260807.tex.
-->

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(here)

source(here::here("code", "_common.R"))
source(here::here("tracks", "fdic-brc-jfqa-aug2026", "code", "_track_common.R"))

save_tables <- TRUE

panel <- readRDS(latest_track_file("panel_smallbank"))
setDT(panel)

dt <- panel[abs(qtrs_since) < 12]
dt[, post := ifelse(qtrs_since > 0, 1, 0)]
dt[, D_DT := as.factor(as.Date(D_DT))]

eqv <- dt[!is.na(equity_assets_22q4), unique(.SD),
          .SDcols = c("ID_RSSD", "equity_assets_22q4")]
p <- quantile(eqv$equity_assets_22q4, c(.01, .99))
dt[, eq22_w := pmin(pmax(equity_assets_22q4, p[1]), p[2])]
dt[, gap := unins_time_deps_assets - ins_time_deps_assets]

setFixest_fml(
  ..c_full = ~ log_total_assets_l1 + equity_assets_l1 + int_expense_assets_l1,
  ..c_noeq = ~ log_total_assets_l1 + int_expense_assets_l1,
  ..fe = ~ ID_RSSD + D_DT
)

dict_ch <- c(covariate_labels_dict, "(Intercept)" = "Constant",
             "gap" = "Unins. $-$ Ins. Time Deps/Assets (\\%)",
             "eq22_w" = "Equity/Assets 2022Q4",
             "post:eq22_w" = "Post x Equity 2022Q4",
             "eq22_w:post" = "Post x Equity 2022Q4",
             "post:cecl_equity:eq22_w" = "Post x CECL Adj x Equity 2022Q4",
             "post:high_cecl_equity:eq22_w" = "Post x High CECL x Equity 2022Q4",
             "cecl_equity:eq22_w" = "CECL Adj x Equity 2022Q4",
             "high_cecl_equity:eq22_w" = "High CECL x Equity 2022Q4")
```

## Capital-buffer interaction battery

```{r}
r <- list(
  feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ post*cecl_equity*eq22_w + ..c_full | ..fe, dt, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ post*cecl_equity*eq22_w + ..c_noeq | ..fe, dt, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ post*high_cecl_equity*eq22_w + ..c_full | ..fe, dt, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(gap ~ post*cecl_equity*eq22_w + ..c_full | ..fe, dt, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(gap ~ post*cecl_equity*eq22_w + ..c_noeq | ..fe, dt, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(gap ~ post*high_cecl_equity*eq22_w + ..c_full | ..fe, dt, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
cat("\n================ CAPITAL HETEROGENEITY ================\n")
etable(r, dict = dict_ch,
       order = c("Post x CECL Adj x Equity 2022Q4", "Post x High CECL x Equity 2022Q4",
                 "Post x CECL Adj", "Post x High CECL"))
export_track_tbl(r, "tbl_capital_het", dict_ch,
                 order = c("Post x CECL Adj x Equity 2022Q4", "Post x High CECL x Equity 2022Q4",
                           "Post x CECL Adj", "Post x High CECL"))

cat("\n================ DIAGNOSTICS ================\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(dt), "| banks:", uniqueN(dt$ID_RSSD), "\n")
cat("eq22 pctiles (raw):\n")
print(round(quantile(eqv$equity_assets_22q4, c(.01,.25,.5,.75,.99)), 2))
cat("winsor bounds:", round(p, 2), "\n")
cat("implied zero-effect capital: level", round(0.3476/0.0275, 1),
    "| gap cont", round(0.8009/0.0665, 1),
    "| gap binary", round(4.117/0.3074, 1), "\n")
```
